management.exposure: management only; never routed from deception, telemetry or attack simulation

deception.cell_bridges: dybr1..dybr254; one exclusive cell per bridge
deception.exposure: only exact inbound service flows and exact per-cell ingest egress

telemetry.exposure: reachable from deception only at the exact ingest endpoint; writes to management Elasticsearch with an independent ingest identity

attack_simulation.exposure: authorized laboratory clients only; exact source addresses are listed in each cell policy

denied_by_design: honeypot to management control, Kibana, Elasticsearch or SSH
honeypot to Internet, DNS, metadata, host or another cell
any workload to a container runtime socket

credentials.honeypot: per-sensor ingest bearer token, provisioned out of band
credentials.ingest_to_elasticsearch: dedicated write-only ingest identity, independent from Kibana and administrator credentials

evidence_limit: Design example only; not a firewall, topology or containment verification.
